digest.component_or_area: rebar engine, LLM evals, metrics registry
propositions: timeout_s parameter in _call_with_retry is accepted but never read, causing caller-supplied timeout_s values intended for wrapped Jira client to be swallowed instead of forwarded
dirty parameter in run_eval signature is never read and no caller passes it, falsely implying eval-provenance source is configurable

module_size_trend and commit_cadence_trend metric seeds are permanently unavailable because their compute function returns None, and their ids are trapped in the registry preventing future real implementations from registering
Placeholder metric ids prevent real implementations from registering cleanly because registry appends only if spec.id is not already present, resulting in silent skip with no error or warning
